record.dic_text:
01134 Ben-Chayil {ben-khah'-yil}

源自 01121 和 02428; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Benhail 1; 1

便亥伊勒 = "力量之子" 或 "大能之子 (人)"
1) 約沙法手下的一名官員 (#代下 17:7|)
record.edic_text:
01134 Ben-Chayil {ben-khah'-yil}

from 01121 and 02428;; n pr m

AV - Benhail 1; 1

Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"
1) a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat
